options.name: sponsor filters / activity window
options.decision_rule: Separate active sponsors, past sponsors, payments and payouts; distinguish cumulative commitment from settled receipts.
options.verification: Read account/timezone/date/currency and reconcile paginated source rows to displayed totals.

options.name: export format / date / delivery
values: supported date window and delivery destination
options.decision_rule: Export only requested scope to intended private destination; initiating emailed export is an external delivery action requiring authorization.
options.verification: Verify requested export fields/window, actual received file and row totals; record pending versus completed export.

options.name: referral metadata syntax
values: metadata_KEY=value; alphanumeric/dash/underscore; at most ten pairs
options.decision_rule: Use non-sensitive short campaign codes, never email addresses or secret identifiers in public URLs. Whitespace/invalid characters can produce 404.
options.verification: Check resulting URL and export metadata key after permitted transaction; keys truncate at 25 chars and values at 100 per current guide.

options.name: lifetime / revenue interpretation
options.decision_rule: Use financial definitions explicitly; sponsorship totals and estimated next payout are not recognized revenue or a tax report.
options.verification: Reconcile refunds/fees/date window with account dashboard and payout receipts when applicable.

pitfalls: Export access does not authorize publishing sponsor identities or payment details in a public Wiki/Project.

groups.title: Recipient scope, sender identity and publish boundary
groups.applicability: Only explicit instructions to contact sponsors; preparing a draft alone does not authorize sending.

options.name: recipients
options.decision_rule: Match requested audience and current opt-in; do not bypass consent with copied sponsor email lists.
options.verification: Read selected tier recipients and current eligibility before publish; distinguish tier names from stable IDs.

options.name: subject / body / sender
values: personal primary email or noreply based on privacy
options.decision_rule: Prepare concrete reviewed content and working links; note personal sender exposure when email privacy is off.
options.verification: Preview sender/subject/body/links and target account in dashboard without sending test mail.

options.name: draft versus Publish
options.decision_rule: Publish sends mail and needs an explicit messaging instruction; repository release/setup authority alone is insufficient.
options.verification: Read publication/sent history and exact target scope; absence of send evidence must remain draft/unknown.

options.name: ambiguous delivery recovery
options.decision_rule: A timeout can occur after sending; do not retry the broadcast before reconciling history and timestamps.
options.verification: Capture update ID, publication time and recipient tier scope; report uncertainty rather than claim all recipients received/read mail.

pitfalls: Published/sent means provider acceptance/history, not proof every recipient received or read the message.

groups.title: Banking boundaries, estimated payouts and fundraising targets
groups.applicability: Sponsors owners managing their own fundraising; goals are public owner decisions and bank changes require exact authority.

options.name: payout account / status
options.decision_rule: Read correct beneficiary/provider and distinguish estimated, pending and paid; never equate incoming sponsorship with completed payout.
options.verification: Match amount/date/currency and account history to actual receipt where available.

options.name: bank/fiscal-host management
options.decision_rule: Owner handles bank/legal verification; fiscal-host accounts cannot directly edit payout information through the same control. Never paste bank/tax data into repository logs.
options.verification: Inspect provider/account gate and resulting secure status only; record support handoff as unresolved.

options.name: receipt export
values: PDF payout receipts for supported Stripe Connect accounts
options.decision_rule: Export only required receipt to the authorized private destination; respect provider-specific availability.
options.verification: Open actual receipt and match account/payout amount/date; dashboard display alone is not exported file evidence.

options.name: goal type / target / description
options.decision_rule: Select an owner-approved measurable target and explain funded work accurately; avoid implying contribution guarantees.
options.verification: Read live goal type/target/text and public progress; only one simultaneous goal is supported in current guide.

options.name: goal edit / remove / share
options.decision_rule: Preserve rationale for target changes and publish/share externally only when requested; progress is not recognized revenue.
options.verification: Re-read public goal after update/removal and inspect embed destination; do not send promotion as setup.

pitfalls: Payout management is provider/account work, not repository administration. Do not claim settled revenue, tax treatment or completed banking verification from GraphQL metadata.

groups.title: Workflow triggers and typed inputs

options.name: on / types
options.values: push, pull_request, pull_request_target, merge_group, schedule, workflow_dispatch, repository_dispatch, workflow_run, workflow_call, release; event-specific activity types
options.decision_rule: Choose the event whose code/ref and trust model match the job. Add merge_group when required checks serve a merge queue.
options.verification: Exercise intended event; record event, actor, head_sha and workflow revision.

options.name: branches / tags / paths
options.values: positive/negative glob lists; branches-ignore/tags-ignore/paths-ignore alternatives
options.decision_rule: Protect required checks against path-filter skips; order negative patterns deliberately; branch and path filters combine.
options.verification: Test included/excluded branch and file combinations; inspect check state.

options.name: schedule
options.values: POSIX cron; UTC; default-branch workflow
options.decision_rule: Use for tolerable delays, with manual recovery; scheduling is not a precise timer.
options.verification: Compare scheduled event timestamp, branch and actual start.

options.name: workflow_dispatch.inputs
options.values: boolean, choice, environment, number, string; required/default/options
options.decision_rule: Validate enum and deployment target; environment input selects a value but does not gate a job without environment.
options.verification: Run default and explicit input values; reject invalid target in job.

options.name: workflow_run
options.values: requested, in_progress, completed; workflows and branches
options.decision_rule: Treat upstream code/artifacts as untrusted; privileged follow-up must verify origin and SHA.
options.verification: Read originating run ID, repository, event, conclusion, SHA and artifact provenance.

options.name: GITHUB_TOKEN event recursion
options.values: Most token-generated events do not launch another workflow; dispatch exceptions exist
options.decision_rule: Use explicit dispatch for intended chaining, with bounded recursion; do not broaden credentials just to trigger CI.
options.verification: Match downstream run to dispatch; confirm no duplicate loop.

pitfalls: A required workflow skipped by filters can leave a required check pending.
pull_request_target operates in privileged base context; never checkout and execute untrusted PR code there.
Schedule delays and dropped scheduling events require observability.
groups.project_applicability: Existing validation CI needs PR and default-branch coverage. Event expansion needs a concrete repository operation.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep trigger edits in reviewed commits; retain event payload metadata without secrets and explain maintainer-triggered runs.
groups.recovery: Inspect event/ref/filters first; dispatch or rerun the exact intended revision only after correcting cause.

groups.title: Jobs, matrices, conditions and run history

options.name: needs / if
options.values: DAG dependencies; success(), failure(), cancelled(), always(); expressions
options.decision_rule: Use explicit terminal handling. Reserve always() for bounded cleanup; avoid making cancellation ineffective.
options.verification: Inspect skipped and failed upstream cases plus cancellation.

options.name: strategy
options.values: matrix axes/include/exclude, fail-fast, max-parallel
options.decision_rule: Test supported platforms; fail-fast false retains all diagnostics at higher cost.
options.verification: Inspect complete matrix job set and all conclusions.

options.name: step execution
options.values: run/uses, id, with, env, shell, working-directory, outputs, defaults
options.decision_rule: Pass untrusted strings through environment or typed inputs rather than shell interpolation.
options.verification: Read exact workflow SHA, command results and produced outputs.

options.name: timeouts / tolerated failures
options.values: job and step timeout-minutes; continue-on-error; retry in command/action
options.decision_rule: Bound resource use; do not mark safety or release validation optional.
options.verification: Force representative failure; ensure required job fails and cleanup completes.

options.name: services / containers
options.values: image, credentials, env, volumes, ports, options; supported runner OS
options.decision_rule: Use when integration tests require services; pin trusted images and isolate credentials.
options.verification: Health-check service and inspect exact image digest.

options.name: attempt operations
options.values: rerun all, failed jobs, one job, debug logging, cancel/force-cancel; delete logs/run
options.decision_rule: Rerun after diagnosis. Capture current attempt; debug logs increase disclosure risk.
options.verification: Record run ID, attempt, job IDs, SHA, conclusion and redacted log URL.

pitfalls: A maintainer investigation of discussion #206259 attributed apparent queue blocking to other group jobs and always() preventing cancellation; initial bug claims were incomplete.
groups.project_applicability: Keep the existing small validation workflow unless real platform differences justify a matrix.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Preserve previous attempts and reviewer explanation; canceled or deleted logs are not proof of an earlier success.
groups.recovery: Read the current attempt before retrying; cancel normally first; force-cancel only after identifying stuck run and external side effects.

groups.title: Actions availability, allowed code and token defaults

options.name: Actions enabled scope
options.values: disabled, all eligible repositories, selected repositories; inherited org/enterprise constraints
options.decision_rule: Read inheritance before changing repository settings.
options.verification: Read all controlling scopes and repository eligibility.

options.name: allowed actions/reusable workflows
options.values: all, local-only, selected; GitHub-owned, verified Marketplace, explicit patterns; SHA-pinning policy where supported
options.decision_rule: Pin reviewed actions; allow only required external automation.
options.verification: Read selected-action patterns and inspect each uses reference.

options.name: default_workflow_permissions
options.values: read or write; per-workflow/per-job permission map
options.decision_rule: Keep repository default read; grant needed write permissions only in responsible job.
options.verification: Inspect setup log effective GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.

options.name: token permission map
options.values: actions, artifact-metadata, attestations, checks, contents, deployments, discussions, id-token, issues, models, packages, pages, pull-requests, security-events, statuses; supported read/write/none values
options.decision_rule: Once any permission is specified, unspecified permissions become none; metadata/scopes and availability differ.
options.verification: Compare permissions to each operation schema and actual run grants.

options.name: PR creation / approval by Actions
options.values: allow or deny workflow PR creation/approval
options.decision_rule: Creation may help automation; automated approval is not independent review and must not satisfy a human governance intent.
options.verification: Read can_approve_pull_request_reviews and inspect actor of resulting review.

options.name: fork policy
options.values: first-time/first-time-with-new-account/all external contributor approval; private-fork run/read-token/write-token/secrets options
options.decision_rule: Run contributions without secrets/write token; approval authorizes code execution and consumes resources.
options.verification: Read fork policy plus run approval actor and effective token.

options.name: policy objects and retention
options.values: schema-defined action policy rules; artifact/log days bounded by parent policy
options.decision_rule: Inspect current rule schema and inherited maximums; retain enough release evidence without storing sensitive logs.
options.verification: Read policy IDs/rules and expiry dates on actual run/artifact.

groups.project_applicability: Repository rules require read-only CI. Do not enable write or fork secrets merely for fuller coverage.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Record who approved contributed code, which SHA was inspected and whether a later update needs review again.
groups.recovery: Revert an allowlist through reviewed policy change; preserve run evidence before lowering retention or deleting logs.

groups.title: Reusable workflows, actions and templates

options.name: sharing and reference
options.values: same-repo path; owner/repo workflow@SHA/tag/branch; private/internal sharing
options.decision_rule: Prefer exact reviewed SHA; access/allowed-actions policies must permit every nested workflow.
options.verification: Read referenced_workflows SHAs and effective access policy.

options.name: workflow_call contract
options.values: boolean/number/string inputs, required/default; explicit secrets; outputs mapped job to workflow
options.decision_rule: Treat inputs/outputs as an API; avoid stringly typed booleans.
options.verification: Run caller with omitted/default/explicit values and check outputs.

options.name: secret forwarding
options.values: named secrets or inherit for supported org/enterprise relationship; forwarding at every nested hop
options.decision_rule: Forward only required names; inheritance is wider. Current docs require passing environment secrets as well.
options.verification: Fail safely when required secret is empty without printing it.

options.name: environment scope
options.values: environment on called job; same-name environment secret wins
options.decision_rule: Caller cannot put environment on a reusable-workflow call job. Pass environment identifier as input and bind it inside called workflow.
options.verification: Observe called job gate and selected environment; verify secret presence only.

options.name: env and outputs
options.values: caller env is not general callee env; job/workflow outputs; reusable matrix output semantics
options.decision_rule: Pass configuration explicitly; use artifacts for files.
options.verification: Assert outputs on representative matrix and nested caller.

options.name: nesting / permissions / concurrency
options.values: supported host nesting limit; accessible chain; permissions can only remain or decrease; caller/callee group IDs
options.decision_rule: Avoid same concurrency key accidentally canceling caller; inspect current host limits rather than hard-code historical limits.
options.verification: Execute complete chain and inspect grants/group.

options.name: action forms and templates
options.values: composite steps, JavaScript runtime, Docker action; organization workflow-templates metadata
options.decision_rule: Use a template for copied starting files; reusable workflow for centrally maintained behavior.
options.verification: Check action.yml inputs/runtime and actual consumer run.

pitfalls: Issue #4453 reports empty environment secrets without forwarding; current official documentation explicitly requires passing or inherit. required:true checks passing, not non-empty value.
groups.project_applicability: Use only if repeated workflows merit a shared contract; small single-repo CI does not need a new abstraction.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Version contract changes, review all callers and record actual called SHA rather than mutable tag only.
groups.recovery: Pin consumer to prior known SHA; restore compatible input/output contract and test caller before broader rollout.

groups.title: Variables, credentials and precedence

options.name: scope / selected repositories
options.values: organization all/private/selected; repository; environment; Actions versus Dependabot secret stores
options.decision_rule: Place credentials in narrowest necessary scope; variables are public-to-readers configuration.
options.verification: Read names/metadata and selected repository IDs.

options.name: same-name precedence
options.values: environment over repository over organization; runtime availability/context restrictions
options.decision_rule: Avoid collisions; check when the job evaluates variables versus when environment values are available.
options.verification: Inspect effective non-sensitive variable and secret-presence check in bound job.

options.name: write protocol
options.values: scope public key plus encrypted_value; gh secret via stdin/secure file
options.decision_rule: Never put secret in arguments, source or issue; encrypted API field is not a retrieval path.
options.verification: Read updated_at/name; exercise minimal authorized operation.

options.name: fork / Dependabot / reusable contexts
options.values: secrets withheld for untrusted fork runs; Dependabot uses its dedicated store; explicit reusable forwarding
options.decision_rule: Do not duplicate broad credentials to fix a context error.
options.verification: Read event actor and correct credential store; negative test unauthorized use.

options.name: rotation / expiry / redaction
options.values: provider revoke/reissue, key owner/expiry metadata outside secret value; add-mask for derived values
options.decision_rule: Rotate at provider; log masking is best effort, not access control.
options.verification: Confirm old credential rejection and new credential operation without outputting either.

groups.project_applicability: Validation should need no repository secret. Dependabot private registries need separate credentials only if present.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Record credential purpose, owner, consumer and rotation date; never plaintext values in historical evidence.
groups.recovery: Revoke exposed credential first; replace narrow secret and rerun safely; remove/redact logs separately.

groups.title: Concurrency and queue policy

options.name: group
options.values: workflow/job scope; expression; repository-wide case-insensitive group name
options.decision_rule: Include workflow/ref for isolated CI; use environment-specific shared key for deployment serialization.
options.verification: Read evaluated group and all related pending/running jobs.

options.name: queue
options.values: single default; max permits up to 100 pending
options.decision_rule: Use single for latest-state jobs; max when every item matters and host supports it.
options.verification: Queue a bounded test and inspect pending replacements/overflow.

options.name: cancel-in-progress
options.values: false/default; true; allowed expression
options.decision_rule: Cancel stale CI; avoid interrupting releases or migrations. queue:max plus true is invalid.
options.verification: Read old run conclusion and ensure side effects stopped.

options.name: ordering
options.values: FIFO by entering concurrency wait, not original dispatch time; no universal dispatch ordering guarantee
options.decision_rule: Do not use queue as a transactional ledger; record intended sequence separately if needed.
options.verification: Compare queue-entry and execution history with expected deployment revisions.

pitfalls: 2021–2025 complaints about a single pending slot do not describe current queue:max behavior; maintainer announced shipping April 17, 2026.
The control-concurrency page contains broad examples implying unconditional cancellation; use its explicit queue/cancel policy definitions.
groups.project_applicability: CI can cancel outdated branch checks; release and Wiki publication must preserve sequence and existing content.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Attach cancellation reason to run history and preserve prior attempt IDs; an operator retry does not establish queue order.
groups.recovery: Inspect every workflow sharing the key and always() conditions before calling a queue bug; check runner availability and status incident history.

groups.title: Workflow artifact contents and lifecycle

options.name: upload contract
options.values: name, path/globs/exclusions, if-no-files-found warn/error/ignore, retention-days
options.decision_rule: Require expected files; choose unique artifact name per matrix job.
options.verification: Download exact artifact ID and inspect archive manifest.

options.name: hidden and file metadata
options.values: include-hidden-files false by default; ZIP changes permission fidelity; tar when metadata matters
options.decision_rule: Include required dotfiles explicitly after excluding credentials; tar executable-sensitive bundles.
options.verification: Check .codex-plugin files and executable bits in extracted release bundle.

options.name: compression / overwrite
options.values: compression-level supported range; overwrite false default; upload version semantics
options.decision_rule: Favor low compression for precompressed assets; overwrite deletes old artifact identity.
options.verification: Record artifact ID, digest, size and expiration after upload.

options.name: download selection
options.values: ID/name/pattern, merge-multiple, path; repository/run/token for cross-run access
options.decision_rule: Bind release input to trusted run and SHA, never latest name alone.
options.verification: Verify source run, digest and expected file allowlist.

options.name: host and action compatibility
options.values: supported major/runtime/backend; GHES support differs from GitHub.com
options.decision_rule: Read current action README and installed runner minimum; do not blindly copy a dot-com major.
options.verification: Run on target host and inspect resulting artifact/download.

pitfalls: Hidden-file default change broke explicit dotfile upload use cases; plugin archives can silently lose .codex-plugin if blindly uploaded.
Artifact download is untrusted data until origin and contents are verified.
groups.project_applicability: Inspect installable plugin archive before release; preservation of hidden plugin metadata is essential.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep archive manifest, digest and trusted producing SHA with release evidence; retention expiry must not erase sole evidence.
groups.recovery: Rebuild from same reviewed SHA, compare contents and digest, issue new version for published immutable mistakes.

groups.title: Cache keys, access and budgets

options.name: lookup identity
options.values: path, key, restore-keys, OS/architecture/lockfile/toolchain salts; cache-version/ref scope
options.decision_rule: Do not mix incompatible binaries; restore prefixes trade hit rate for stale input risk.
options.verification: Inspect exact key/ref/version and restored build behavior.

options.name: restore controls
options.values: lookup-only, fail-on-cache-miss, enableCrossOsArchive, supported restore/save actions
options.decision_rule: Fail on miss only when cache existence is an actual requirement; cache is ordinarily optional.
options.verification: Test empty cache and prefix fallback; verify reproducible cold build.

options.name: write/eviction
options.values: immutable key entry; new key for changed content; retention/storage policies
options.decision_rule: Avoid secrets and release-only evidence; monitor eviction and thrashing.
options.verification: Read usage, last_accessed_at, size and configured inherited limits.

options.name: trust boundary
options.values: fork/base/default-branch read visibility and write scope; workflow cache access restrictions
options.decision_rule: Treat cache as untrusted executable input; separate privileged/untrusted scopes.
options.verification: Verify trust-specific keys/access plus authorized clean-cache build.

groups.project_applicability: Small Python stdlib validation does not justify a cache unless measured runtime benefit exists.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep cache purge reason and old keys in issue/run evidence, never cache credential contents.
groups.recovery: Delete only identified poisoned/stale keys; rerun cold, then change salt to prevent accidental reuse.

groups.title: Hosted, self-hosted and larger runner configuration

options.name: runs-on selection
options.values: hosted image/architecture/size; self-hosted label intersection; group plus labels
options.decision_rule: Use smallest suitable hosted runner; image labels can roll, so record actual image version.
options.verification: Inspect job runner_name/group/labels/OS and setup image version.

options.name: self-hosted registration
options.values: repository/org scope; short-lived registration/removal tokens; JIT config; ephemeral flag
options.decision_rule: Use disposable isolated machines for untrusted work; registration is not host hardening.
options.verification: Run benign job, confirm isolation and disposal/cleanup.

options.name: group access
options.values: all/selected repositories; public repo option; selected workflows/revisions; inherited org/enterprise policy
options.decision_rule: Restrict trusted runner group to known workflows and repos.
options.verification: Read group repository IDs and allowed workflow refs; test excluded workflow refusal.

options.name: host lifecycle
options.values: runner version/update policy, online/busy, labels, proxy, workspace cleanup; ARC scale sets
options.decision_rule: Patch runner and images; bound queue and jobs; autoscaling requires separate infrastructure.
options.verification: Check runner health and clean job-to-job environment.

options.name: larger runner settings
options.values: machine type/image/size/max parallelism, runner group, static IP/private networking where eligible
options.decision_rule: Enable only for a demonstrated workload and approved billing/network access.
options.verification: Read saved runner config, network reachability and billed usage.

groups.project_applicability: No current need for paid or self-hosted capacity in this plugin repository.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Capture operator registration/removal and host ownership, preserving relevant job logs before disposal.
groups.recovery: Quarantine suspect runner, revoke credentials, replace image; never assume workspace deletion undoes compromise.

groups.title: OIDC claims and cloud trust

options.name: issuance permission
options.values: id-token:write only on authenticating job
options.decision_rule: Token issuance grants no cloud resource permission by itself.
options.verification: Inspect effective job permission and provider exchange result.

options.name: trust conditions
options.values: issuer, audience, repository identity, ref/environment, job_workflow_ref; provider-supported claims
options.decision_rule: Scope provider trust to exact owner/repo/workflow/target; avoid broad wildcard repo trust.
options.verification: Inspect redacted claims and denied wrong-ref/target exchange.

options.name: subject template
options.values: repo use_default; org/repo include_claim_keys; supported custom properties
options.decision_rule: Stage cloud trust migration before changing sub format; org template requires correct repo adoption.
options.verification: Read template and compare actual non-sensitive sub/claim values.

options.name: reusable workflow identity
options.values: caller repository context versus called job_workflow_ref; accessible trust claims
options.decision_rule: Require reviewed reusable workflow identity where provider supports it.
options.verification: Inspect caller/callee SHAs and successful narrow provider action.

options.name: environment interaction
options.values: environment-based subject replaces ref-based shape; branch rules are separate gate
options.decision_rule: Configure both cloud subject and GitHub deployment branch policy.
options.verification: Negative-test disallowed ref and unapproved environment job.

groups.project_applicability: No cloud deploy target currently exists; do not create one to exercise OIDC.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Record cloud role/trust policy revision and migration review, never JWT contents.
groups.recovery: Restore previous subject template or compatible provider trust; revoke exposed long-lived credentials separately.

groups.title: Environment protection and approvals

options.name: required reviewers
options.values: eligible users/teams; one eligible approval suffices; prevent self-review; plan restrictions
options.decision_rule: Do not describe reviewer list as unanimous approval. Independent approval requires another eligible human.
options.verification: Read reviewer IDs, prevent_self_review and actual approval actor.

options.name: wait timer
options.values: documented minute range; non-billable waiting; product/visibility gates
options.decision_rule: Use only for purposeful rollout delay; it does not inspect health.
options.verification: Read wait duration and timestamps before job starts.

options.name: deployment branch policy
options.values: all; protected branches; selected branch/tag patterns
options.decision_rule: Gate deployment ref separately from repository branch protection; test tags explicitly.
options.verification: Read protected_branches/custom_branch_policies and every branch/tag rule.

options.name: administrator bypass
options.values: allow/deny supported protection bypass setting
options.decision_rule: Keep bypass decision explicit and auditable; automation must not bypass its own gate.
options.verification: Read saved option plus bypass actor/comment when used.

options.name: custom protection rules
options.values: installed GitHub App rules; enabled rules bounded by current platform limit
options.decision_rule: Verify app permission, external approval/health decision and failure handling.
options.verification: Read rule integration IDs and actual requested/approved/rejected record.

options.name: environment configuration
options.values: name, URL, secrets, variables; create explicitly before referencing
options.decision_rule: A misspelled environment may be created without intended safeguards; exact name matters.
options.verification: Read environment ID and settings before allowing workflow run.

options.name: approval operations
options.values: pending deployments approve/reject with comment; workflow gate differs from PR approval
options.decision_rule: Read artifact/SHA and change context before approval; never impersonate reviewer or weaken policy.
options.verification: Record deployment IDs, reviewer, decision, comment and run continuation.

groups.project_applicability: A single maintainer cannot manufacture independent peer approval. No deployable service exists; preserve zero required PR approvals as repository policy.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: PR review, fork workflow execution approval and environment approval are distinct histories; record each real actor/decision.
groups.recovery: Reject unsafe pending deployment, correct exact environment/ref and rerun; do not remove protection to unblock automation.

groups.title: Deployment records, statuses and rollback

options.name: deployment request
options.values: ref, task, payload, environment, description, auto_merge, required_contexts, transient_environment, production_environment
options.decision_rule: Bind immutable SHA and required checks; deployment API is a record/request, not deployment engine.
options.verification: Read record ID, sha, environment and exact request parameters.

options.name: status transitions
options.values: queued, pending, in_progress, success, failure, error, inactive; log_url, environment_url, auto_inactive
options.decision_rule: Report actual engine state and measured health.
options.verification: Read ordered statuses and independently test application version/health.

options.name: cleanup/rollback
options.values: mark inactive; delete eligible deployment; external rollback to prior immutable artifact
options.decision_rule: Preserve operational trail; deactivate previews when removed.
options.verification: Compare served SHA/digest before/after and status history.

groups.project_applicability: Only create deployment records for an actual deployment; source/plugin release alone is not an application deployment.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Store approver, release artifact digest and rollback reason in deployment/linked issue history.
groups.recovery: Deploy prior verified artifact with a new explicit rollback record; a green API status does not restore service.

groups.title: Security products, inheritance and enforcement

options.name: product switches
options.values: dependency graph/submission; Dependabot alerts/security updates; Code Security; Secret Protection; private vulnerability reporting
options.decision_rule: Evaluate eligibility and actual need separately; security policy prose is not scanning enablement.
options.verification: Read effective repository security_and_analysis and product-specific status.

options.name: configuration association
options.values: org/enterprise configuration ID; selected/all/new-repository defaults; enforcement
options.decision_rule: Preserve inherited policy; inspect asynchronous association failures and product entitlements.
options.verification: Read configuration, repository association/application state and effective setting.

options.name: enforced controls
options.values: enabled/disabled/not-set where schema supports; enforcement mode; delegated dismissal/bypass
options.decision_rule: Validate current schema per field rather than applying one enum blindly.
options.verification: Read exact serialized config plus repository lock state.

options.name: coverage/risk
options.values: repository filters, missing coverage, exclusions, alert severity/age; eligible plan
options.decision_rule: Report unknown/unavailable separately from clean or disabled.
options.verification: Reconcile visible repo counts and excluded/failed scans with ledger.

groups.project_applicability: Public plugin can use eligible free controls; do not activate a paid organizational product or change license policy without authorization.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Retain setting changes, application status, responsible security owner and policy exception explanation.
groups.recovery: Correct failed association or incompatible config; preserve evidence before detaching and never silently relax enforcement.

groups.title: CodeQL, SARIF, Autofix and code quality

options.name: setup mode
options.values: default or advanced; language selection; query suite; supported runner
options.decision_rule: Choose default for supported uncomplicated builds; advanced for custom build/query needs.
options.verification: Verify actual language database and completed analysis at intended SHA.

options.name: advanced options
options.values: matrix languages, build-mode none/autobuild/manual, paths/paths-ignore, queries/packs/model packs, config-file, category, schedule
options.decision_rule: Match build mode to language; path excludes can create blind spots. Keep category stable per analysis variant.
options.verification: Read workflow/config at analyzed SHA and analysis category/language coverage.

options.name: blocking controls
options.values: security/quality severities, rule/tool selection, ruleset thresholds where supported
options.decision_rule: Pick actionable severity gates and require actual scan completion; empty upload is not clean coverage.
options.verification: Inspect PR check result and corresponding alerts/instances.

options.name: SARIF upload
options.values: tool/category, commit_sha, ref, analysis_key, compressed payload; processing status
options.decision_rule: Validate SARIF and bind result to exact commit/ref; poll until processed.
options.verification: Read sarif processing result and analysis commit/tool/category.

options.name: alert lifecycle
options.values: open/fixed/dismissed; allowed dismissal reason/comment; delegated review
options.decision_rule: Dismiss with evidence; reopen when premise fails. Deleting analysis is not remediation.
options.verification: Read state, dismissing actor/time/reason and latest instance.

options.name: Autofix / AI Scan
options.values: available product switch; supported alert request; proposed patch/commit
options.decision_rule: Review generated diff and test before committing; do not equate generated fix with validated fix.
options.verification: Rerun affected tests/scanner and inspect resolved finding.

options.name: variant databases / code quality
options.values: CodeQL database downloads/variant target scope; quality setup/findings supported schema
options.decision_rule: Use only for concrete cross-repository query/quality need; permissions differ from code scanning.
options.verification: Read variant completion per repo and quality findings at target revision.

groups.project_applicability: Analyze actual Python/scripts and workflow languages supported by selected tool; do not claim Markdown guidance has executable-language CodeQL coverage.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Preserve alert number, instance, reviewer rationale and scan SHA; approvals for dismissal remain separate from fix review.
groups.recovery: Fix build/query/upload cause; rescan same intended revision; reopen unsupported dismissals and revert unsafe Autofix commit.

groups.title: Dependency graph, review, submission and SBOM

options.name: inventory sources
options.values: supported manifests/lockfiles, automatic or explicit dependency submission; detector/job identity
options.decision_rule: Resolve build dependencies where manifests are insufficient; do not fabricate runtime dependencies.
options.verification: Match graph snapshot detector and SHA to lockfile/build resolution.

options.name: dependency-review policy
options.values: base/head diff; fail-on-severity, allowed/denied licenses, scope, allowlisted advisories/packages; supported action options
options.decision_rule: Use narrow documented exceptions with owner/expiry; license policy requires owner decision.
options.verification: Inspect newly introduced vulnerable/license entries and check failure.

options.name: SBOM
options.values: SPDX export; async report UUID where supported; snapshot date and included scopes
options.decision_rule: Treat as inventory snapshot bounded by graph completeness.
options.verification: Parse SPDX and compare package counts/versions to manifests and submission.

options.name: advisory matching
options.values: GHSA/CVE, ecosystem/name, affected/fixed range, withdrawn/reviewed status
options.decision_rule: Match precise version and ecosystem; absence of advisory is not safety proof.
options.verification: Read advisory update time, withdrawn state and installed resolved version.

groups.project_applicability: No new runtime dependency is authorized. Track action dependencies and required tooling; owner has not selected project license.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep dated SBOM/diff, dependency exception reviewer and changed lockfiles with PR evidence.
groups.recovery: Submit corrected snapshot and regenerate SBOM; fix affected version or record bounded reviewed exception.

groups.title: Dependabot schedules, update strategy and runtime

options.name: update discovery
options.values: version:2; package-ecosystem; directory/directories; exclude-paths where supported
options.decision_rule: Configure every existing ecosystem, avoiding overlapping directory entries.
options.verification: Inspect default-branch config and real job detected manifests.

options.name: schedule
options.values: daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/semiannually/yearly/cron where current schema supports; day/time/timezone/cronjob
options.decision_rule: Choose workload-appropriate cadence; timezone explicit when needed.
options.verification: Read actual scheduled job timestamps.

options.name: selection/strategy
options.values: allow; ignore dependency/version/update-types; versioning-strategy; target-branch; vendor; ecosystem-specific options
options.decision_rule: Review exclusions carefully: ignored vulnerable versions can block remediation.
options.verification: Compare generated diff and job skipped-dependency reason.

options.name: groups
options.values: patterns/exclude-patterns, dependency-type, update-types, applies-to version-updates/security-updates; multi-ecosystem-groups
options.decision_rule: Use separate security/version intent; grouping failures need real job inspection.
options.verification: Inspect generated PR members and applicable group.

options.name: cooldown
options.values: default-days; semver-major/minor/patch-days; include/exclude; default 3 days
options.decision_rule: Current 2026 default delays version updates even with no cooldown block; security updates are exempt.
options.verification: Compare release publication, cooldown and PR creation time.

options.name: PR management
options.values: open-pull-requests-limit, labels, assignees, milestone, commit-message, branch separator, rebase-strategy; supported options per ecosystem
options.decision_rule: Preserve existing repository taxonomy; keep limits low enough for maintainable review.
options.verification: Inspect generated PR metadata and rebase behavior.

options.name: registry/code execution
options.values: registries credential type/URL; selected registries; insecure-external-code-execution allow/deny
options.decision_rule: Allow external execution only for necessary reviewed ecosystem resolution; narrow registry credentials.
options.verification: Read redacted registry resolution logs and execution settings.

options.name: runtime / repository access
options.values: standard/labeled runner, labels/group; org private-dependency repository allowlist/default access
options.decision_rule: Use labeled runner only on eligible repo; do not expand private repo access to fix typo.
options.verification: Read effective runner settings and successful dependency resolution.

options.name: alerts/security PRs
options.values: severity/ecosystem/package/scope/state/EPSS filters; auto-triage rules and delegated dismissal if eligible
options.decision_rule: Prioritize real risk; dismissal requires reason and does not patch.
options.verification: Read alert after merged fix and confirm installed version/checks.

pitfalls: Maintainer announcement July 14, 2026 confirms 3-day default version cooldown; older explanations assuming immediate version PRs are stale.
Issue #16319 reports grouping failure in a particular non-root npm case; it is a reproduction lead, not proof all grouping is broken.
groups.project_applicability: Existing policy explicitly wants GitHub Actions updates. Add other ecosystems only if manifests exist.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Respond to supported @dependabot commands after reading bot status; human review remains required under repo rules, and bot actor restrictions affect secrets.
groups.recovery: Read update log before rebase/recreate; remove obsolete ignore, fix registry access narrowly, rerun supported job and verify generated PR.

groups.title: Secret detection, push protection and exceptions

options.name: detection options
options.values: provider patterns, non-provider/generic/AI detection where eligible; validity checks; extended metadata
options.decision_rule: Enable supported useful detection; validity/metadata may contact provider and have product gates.
options.verification: Read settings and scan history/coverage, not alert count alone.

options.name: push protection
options.values: repository protection versus personal protection; supported pattern participation
options.decision_rule: Do not mistake personal block for repository policy; repository scanning remains separate.
options.verification: Read repository setting and safe documented test result.

options.name: custom patterns
options.values: name, secret regex, before/after context, additional match requirements; dry-run/publish; push protection
options.decision_rule: Use safe synthetic examples and negative corpus; dry-run before publishing noisy pattern.
options.verification: Record pattern ID/version and positive/negative results.

options.name: bypass governance
options.values: test/false-positive/fix-later reasons where offered; delegated reviewers, expiry/review path
options.decision_rule: Never bypass a valid live credential; fix/revoke instead. Independent reviewer decision stays with reviewer.
options.verification: Read request, actor, comment, expiry and resulting alert.

options.name: alert state
options.values: open/resolved; revoked, false_positive, used_in_tests, wont_fix or current schema reasons; location/history
options.decision_rule: Revoke with provider first; resolving UI alert does not revoke token or erase history.
options.verification: Check provider revocation and read alert location/resolution metadata.

options.name: dismissal governance
options.values: direct or delegated dismissal; role eligibility; notification/review state
options.decision_rule: Confirm reviewer coverage before enforcing; preserve rationale even for test secrets.
options.verification: Read request/outcome, reviewer and reopened state if rejected.

groups.project_applicability: Useful for public repo; synthetic tests must not leak live values. Security setting read may itself contain secret values; redact outputs.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Retain private alert IDs, discovery/rotation timestamps and reviewed exception reasons; do not copy secret strings into public issues.
groups.recovery: Revoke at provider, replace consumers and scan history; history rewriting is separate consequential work and does not invalidate copied credentials.

groups.title: Confidential reports, advisory publication and campaigns

options.name: reporting policy
options.values: SECURITY.md supported versions/contact; private vulnerability reporting enabled/disabled
options.decision_rule: Provide confidential route and realistic response ownership.
options.verification: Inspect rendered policy and actual reporting availability.

options.name: advisory content
options.values: draft/published/withdrawn, severity/CVSS/CWE, vulnerable ranges/patched versions, references, credit, CVE request
options.decision_rule: Keep report private until fix/disclosure agreement; verify affected ranges.
options.verification: Read advisory state/collaborators and clean install of patched release.

options.name: collaboration
options.values: report triage, comments, invited collaborators, temporary private fix fork
options.decision_rule: Grant only necessary confidential access and retain reporter coordination.
options.verification: Read actual collaborator identities and private fork/review history.

options.name: campaign setup
options.values: selected code alerts, repositories, managers/teams, contact, deadline; draft UI versus published API; optional generated issues
options.decision_rule: Use for multi-repository remediation requiring tracking; preserve private finding visibility.
options.verification: Read published campaign scope/counts and corresponding resolved alerts.

options.name: publication / withdrawal
options.values: explicit publish/CVE disclosure; withdrawal constraints; notification effects
options.decision_rule: Publication is irreversible disclosure; prepare exact reviewed advisory/fix before authorized publish.
options.verification: Read public GHSA/CVE and release timestamps; verify issue scope.

groups.project_applicability: Confidential reporting is useful; campaigns require actual alert program and owner eligibility, not a placeholder.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Preserve reporter credits, embargo agreement, fix review and disclosure decision privately; public release notes must respect agreed timing.
groups.recovery: Correct advisory affected ranges/notes and notify existing recipients; never claim withdrawal removes already disclosed information.

groups.title: Drafts, generated notes, assets and immutability

options.name: release identity
options.values: tag_name, target_commitish for new tag, name, draft, prerelease, make_latest
options.decision_rule: Existing tag determines commit; target_commitish does not move it. Match plugin manifest version to v-tag.
options.verification: Resolve tag object/commit, release ID and version file.

options.name: notes
options.values: body; generated notes; previous tag/configuration; categories/exclusions; discussion category where eligible
options.decision_rule: Review generated changelog; include install commands, validation evidence and limits.
options.verification: Read rendered notes and linked issues/PRs against intended range.

options.name: asset upload
options.values: binary content type, filename/label; draft upload URL; per-asset ID/digest/size
options.decision_rule: Build deterministic installable archive, inspect hidden files and allowlist before attaching.
options.verification: Download attached bytes and compare SHA-256/archive manifest.

options.name: immutability
options.values: repo/org policy; new release behavior; immutable flag
options.decision_rule: Create draft, attach every asset, then publish. Published assets/tag become locked; notes/title/latest/prerelease remain editable.
options.verification: Read immutable flag, tag SHA, asset digest and release attestation.

options.name: publication/recovery
options.values: draft update versus publish; prerelease/stable; delete constraints; corrective next version
options.decision_rule: Do not publish from merely prepared source; irreversible distribution needs existing release authorization.
options.verification: Read published_at, exact asset bytes, install from release and latest pointer.

groups.project_applicability: Core delivery path: plugin version, v-tag, installation docs and validation evidence must agree. Immutability prevents patching published archive.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Record release preparer/reviewer/publisher, reviewed tag SHA and prior release comparison. Discussion and release notes carry human feedback/history.
groups.recovery: For immutable wrong asset/tag, publish a new corrected version; editable notes cannot change locked bytes. Never force-move tag as an assumed recovery.

groups.title: Provenance, SBOM and linked artifact records

options.name: statement type
options.values: build provenance or SBOM attestation; artifact digest/name; supported registry publication
options.decision_rule: Attest exact distributed bytes; provenance says how/where built, not absence of bugs.
options.verification: Verify subject digest and trusted repository/workflow identity.

options.name: workflow grants
options.values: id-token:write, attestations:write; contents/read and packages/write only when needed
options.decision_rule: Isolate attestation in trusted release job; eligibility varies with visibility/plan.
options.verification: Inspect effective permissions and successful verify output.

options.name: verification constraints
options.values: trusted owner/repo/workflow, predicate type, signer identity, source ref/commit; offline/bundle modes where supported
options.decision_rule: Do not accept any valid GitHub signature; require intended producer.
options.verification: Run gh attestation verify against downloaded exact asset and identity policy.

options.name: linked artifacts
options.values: storage metadata and artifact association using current endpoint schema
options.decision_rule: Distinguish storage record/link from uploaded file and signed attestation.
options.verification: Read link identity, digest and referenced object existence.

groups.project_applicability: Consider for installable release artifact when trusted workflow builds it; record unavailable eligibility instead of assuming.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep verifier command/policy/output and producing workflow SHA with release record; release attestation and custom build provenance are distinct.
groups.recovery: Rebuild/re-attest correct bytes in trusted workflow; revoke trust in compromised producer and publish corrective version.

groups.title: Registries, package ACL and trusted publishing

options.name: registry/form
options.values: OCI/GHCR, npm, NuGet, RubyGems granular; Maven/Gradle repository-scoped; host support
options.decision_rule: Choose only ecosystem actually distributed; REST metadata does not publish package bytes.
options.verification: Install/pull exact version/digest from clean intended consumer.

options.name: authentication
options.values: GITHUB_TOKEN packages:read/write in workflow; supported classic PAT scopes for registry; registry-specific OIDC/trusted publishing
options.decision_rule: Prefer short-lived workflow credential; trusted-publishing support is registry-specific, not universal.
options.verification: Verify exact registry trust configuration and authenticated clean install.

options.name: link and inheritance
options.values: repository link, inherited repository permissions, automatic inheritance org policy; explicit user/team ACL
options.decision_rule: Linked repo alone may not grant workflow access if ACL inheritance differs.
options.verification: Read package settings/inheritance and intended principal access.

options.name: Actions access
options.values: selected repository access to granular package; separate Codespaces access
options.decision_rule: Grant only consumer/producer repos; token scope alone cannot override package ACL.
options.verification: Test authorized workflow and excluded repo denial.

options.name: visibility
options.values: private/internal/public where supported; public transitions can be restricted/irreversible
options.decision_rule: Do not infer public package from public source repository.
options.verification: Read package visibility and anonymous pull when intended.

options.name: versions/delete/restore
options.values: immutable consumer digest, tags, version metadata; package/version deletion; restoration eligibility/window
options.decision_rule: Do not delete versions still used; inspect downloads and restoration constraints first.
options.verification: Read version ID and digest; restore and reinstall when authorized.

options.name: external trusted publisher
options.values: owner/repository/workflow/environment binding; OIDC permission and registry policy
options.decision_rule: For npm or other external registry, distinguish that registry from GitHub Packages. Verify registry official docs.
options.verification: Perform registry-specific dry-run or publish only with release authorization; read resulting provenance.

pitfalls: Community reports show packages:write token permission alone did not fix missing package inheritance/Actions access; inspect both.
Classic PAT restrictions and SSO can block registry auth despite scope. Do not respond by granting broader scopes blindly.
groups.project_applicability: GITHUB.md explicitly says no separate package artifact requirement. Plugin marketplace/source releases currently satisfy distribution; do not publish artificial package.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Retain package/version IDs, producer SHA, ACL reviewers and deprecation notices; preserve consumer compatibility.
groups.recovery: Correct package ACL/link narrowly; rotate exposed tokens; publish corrected immutable version/digest instead of relying on mutable tags.

groups.title: Pages source, DNS, TLS and publication

options.name: build_type / source
options.values: legacy branch path root/docs or workflow; branch; custom workflow upload/deploy
options.decision_rule: Use source matching actual site generator; branch commits using GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger branch Pages build.
options.verification: Read Pages configuration and actual successful build/deployment SHA.

options.name: workflow grants / target
options.values: contents:read, pages:write, id-token:write; github-pages environment and artifact
options.decision_rule: Scope deployment permissions to job and keep environment protections.
options.verification: Read uploaded Pages artifact, deployment status and environment.

options.name: custom domain
options.values: CNAME, DNS A/AAAA/CNAME records, domain verification, protected domain ownership
options.decision_rule: Verify domain before linking and remove stale DNS when disabling.
options.verification: Read DNS health, ownership record and served hostname.

options.name: HTTPS
options.values: certificate provisioning and https_enforced when available
options.decision_rule: Wait for valid certificate before enforcing; inspect mixed content.
options.verification: Verify HTTPS chain/hostname and HTTP redirect.

options.name: visibility / path
options.values: project site base path, public/private enterprise entitlement; repository visibility differs
options.decision_rule: Do not publish private source content without intended audience decision.
options.verification: Fetch as intended anonymous/authenticated user and inspect base-path assets.

options.name: build/history/recovery
options.values: branch build/request; workflow Pages deployment status/cancel; external health
options.decision_rule: A successful build does not prove correct public content.
options.verification: Fetch expected marker/version, navigation/assets and custom-domain redirect.

groups.project_applicability: No site requirement exists in GITHUB.md; keep Pages not-applicable until useful published site is requested.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Record domain owner authorization, workflow approval and deployed SHA; preserve previous successful deployment for rollback.
groups.recovery: Redeploy prior verified site revision; correct source/base path/DNS, then recheck served bytes and TLS; deleting Pages alone leaves dangerous stale DNS.

groups.title: Required check identity and review integration

options.name: check run
options.values: name, head_sha, status/conclusion, started/completed timestamps, output/annotations, details_url; app identity
options.decision_rule: Stable unique names per required check; attach to exact tested SHA.
options.verification: Read check name, app ID, head_sha and actual command evidence.

options.name: check suite
options.values: automatic creation preferences, rerequest, suite status
options.decision_rule: Suite success does not replace individual required checks; some writes are App-only.
options.verification: Read suite and associated run conclusions.

options.name: commit status
options.values: context, state pending/success/failure/error, target_url, description
options.decision_rule: Keep context distinct from check-run names to avoid ambiguous requirement matching.
options.verification: Read combined and individual statuses on intended SHA.

options.name: protection binding
options.values: required context/app, strict branch freshness, merge_group coverage; skipped/neutral semantics
options.decision_rule: Read rulesets and classic protection; require checks that actually test code.
options.verification: Observe PR required check evaluation after latest push and merge-queue test commit.

groups.project_applicability: Existing three validation commands remain authoritative. Peer approval count zero is deliberate single-maintainer policy.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Keep reviewer comments, check rerequest actor, force-push/stale-review history and final merge SHA; green unrelated SHA is insufficient.
groups.recovery: Fix missing event/name/app permission and rerun actual required check; never spoof status or remove protection to merge.

groups.title: Agentic workflows and constrained output

options.name: definition / compilation
options.values: Markdown instructions plus frontmatter; generated workflow; gh aw compile
options.decision_rule: Review generated YAML after instruction change and keep compiled artifact synchronized.
options.verification: Compile and compare source/generated diff; inspect actual workflow SHA.

options.name: engine / credentials
options.values: supported Copilot/Codex/Claude/Gemini engine; engine-specific secret and billing
options.decision_rule: Choose only an authorized available engine and narrow authentication.
options.verification: Check engine initialization and approved usage budget without exposing keys.

options.name: guardrails
options.values: read-only runtime, firewall/network, tools, explicit safe-outputs and threat-detection gates
options.decision_rule: Allow only requested outputs; proposed issue/comment/PR is still external action requiring existing authorization.
options.verification: Inspect generated downstream write job permissions and resulting object IDs.

options.name: review / triggers
options.values: schedule/dispatch/events; allowed actors; human-reviewed PR outputs
options.decision_rule: Treat repository text as untrusted prompt input; retain human review before merge/deploy.
options.verification: Exercise controlled input and inspect output safety/review history.

groups.project_applicability: Optional automation needs concrete recurring task, engine eligibility and authorized outputs; ordinary deterministic validation is sufficient now.
groups.historical_and_human_interaction: Retain prompts/config revisions, generated proposals, human acceptance/rejection and exact downstream writes; do not call model output an independent approval.
groups.recovery: Disable affected workflow, stop pending writes and revoke compromised credentials; fix prompt/tool policy and inspect all emitted changes before reenable.

groups.title: Organization member privileges and effective access

options.name: Base repository permission
options.values: none | read | write | admin; REST documented default read
options.decision_rule: Recommend none for private least-privilege organizations, then explicit teams; preserve existing grants. Internal repositories remain readable to enterprise members.
options.verification: Read default_repository_permission and test effective access of a representative ordinary member.

options.name: Member repository creation
options.values: members_can_create_public_repositories/private_repositories/internal_repositories: boolean per visibility
options.decision_rule: Use separate visibility controls; enterprise may prohibit internal/public creation. Do not send closing-down members_allowed_repository_creation_type.
options.verification: Read each flag and inherited enterprise constraint.

options.name: Member administrative powers
options.values: members_can_delete_repositories; members_can_change_repo_visibility; members_can_invite_outside_collaborators; members_can_create_teams; members_can_delete_issues: booleans
options.decision_rule: Choose each separately; broad repository admin authority does not authorize destructive actions in this session.
options.verification: Read flags plus actual repository administrators; record inherited restrictions.

options.name: Public identity versus billing contact
options.values: name/company/blog/location/public email/description versus billing_email
options.decision_rule: Publish only owner-approved contact data; billing address stays private.
options.verification: Inspect public profile signed out and billing contact through owner-only settings.

options.name: Invitation and membership
options.values: invitation pending/failed; organization role member/admin; member visibility private/public
options.decision_rule: Invite exact login/email and chosen role; wait for acceptance and required identity setup. Never infer full membership from public members.
options.verification: Read invitations and authenticated membership; verify access after acceptance.

options.name: Outside collaborator conversion/removal
options.values: organization member versus outside collaborator; repository role per grant
options.decision_rule: Inventory team access and owned responsibilities first; explicit offboarding scope includes deploy keys/App access, not just user removal.
options.verification: Read remaining direct/team/base grants and outstanding invitations after change.

pitfalls: REST response examples are not tenant defaults. Base changes affect existing members too; private forks require separate inspection.
A lower direct grant cannot subtract higher base/team/custom-role access.

groups.title: Nested teams and delegated roles

options.name: Team privacy
options.values: secret | closed; new non-nested REST default secret, child default closed
options.decision_rule: Set explicitly: closed for discoverable normal teams; secret cannot have parent/children.
options.verification: Read privacy and parent for every team, including secret teams through owner identity.

options.name: Hierarchy and identity
options.values: parent_team_id or parent_team_slug; ID takes precedence
options.decision_rule: Keep existing team IDs; resolve current slug after rename; verify inherited repository grants.
options.verification: Read parent/children and effective repository access for child member.

options.name: Mention notifications
options.values: notifications_enabled | notifications_disabled; default enabled
options.decision_rule: Disable only intentionally; CODEOWNERS/team mentions must reach responsible humans.
options.verification: Read notification_setting; ask intended maintainers to verify receipt during authorized collaboration.

options.name: Team member authority
options.values: member | maintainer; pending invitation versus active membership
options.decision_rule: Maintainer is team administration, not organization owner. Team creator becomes maintainer automatically. IdP-synced membership is changed at IdP.
options.verification: Read team membership role/state and synchronization mapping.

options.name: Repository roles
options.values: read/triage/write/maintain/admin in UI; pull/push map to read/write in team REST; custom role name/ID
options.decision_rule: Assign the least role needed; check combined base/direct/team/custom permissions.
options.verification: Read permission sources and a representative allowed/denied operation.

options.name: Custom role definition
options.values: base repository role plus additional permission identifiers; organization role permissions from fine-grained-permission discovery
options.decision_rule: Discover currently allowed identifiers, dependencies and plan; do not hard-code an old permission list. Separate definition from user/team assignment.
options.verification: Read role definitions, assigned users/teams and inherited permissions before deleting or replacing a role.

options.name: Security manager migration
options.values: organization roles assignment; legacy security-managers routes retiring
options.decision_rule: Use current organization role discovery; preserve historical role-change evidence and existing assignments.
options.verification: Read replacement role and exact affected users/teams; record unsupported legacy endpoint response.

pitfalls: Secret-team names can appear in mention text. A successful visible-team list does not prove no secret team exists.
Do not remove a role as a shortcut to reconciling assignments; recover original role and grants first.

groups.title: SSO, provisioning, 2FA and account recovery

options.name: Organization SAML connection
options.values: Sign on URL; Issuer; public certificate; enabled versus required
options.decision_rule: Configure/test first, authenticate owner at least once, preserve offline recovery codes; only then enforce.
options.verification: Test IdP login and inspect list of members GitHub proposes removing before confirmation.

options.name: Enterprise SAML inheritance
options.values: enterprise enforced versus organization configuration
options.decision_rule: Enterprise enforcement overrides organization SAML; assess every organization and service credential before rollout.
options.verification: Verify effective connection and representative member login across affected organizations.

options.name: Provisioning model
options.values: ordinary account invitations; organization SCIM; Enterprise Managed Users SCIM
options.decision_rule: Identify model before changing users. IdP governs managed-user lifecycle; ordinary local invitation is not an EMU substitute.
options.verification: Read external identity, active state and group/team mapping with correct host API.

options.name: Authentication assurance
options.values: 2FA required yes/no; allowed 2FA methods per actual host policy; passkeys/security keys/recovery methods
options.decision_rule: Inventory impacted users and service accounts, notify humans, retain independent recovery methods; enforcement requires access-impact authorization.
options.verification: Read requirement and member compliance; verify owners retain a tested recovery route.

options.name: Verified/approved domains
options.values: DNS verification record; verified domain; notification-domain restriction where available
options.decision_rule: Verify DNS ownership before restricting notifications; record DNS lifecycle owner.
options.verification: Read verification and send destinations; do not confuse verified domain with automatic SSO provisioning.

options.name: Offboarding and recovery
options.values: suspend/deprovision; remove membership; revoke SSO credential; revoke token; delete account are distinct
options.decision_rule: Record actor/subject IDs, teams, grants and recovery constraints; choose reversible suspension when it meets request.
options.verification: Check effective denial and preserved records; use documented recovery rather than recreating identity blindly.

pitfalls: Enforcing organization SAML can remove members who have not authenticated with IdP. Downloading recovery codes into logs exposes recovery access.
SCIM deprovisioning, IdP group deletion and GitHub membership removal are different effects; verify all required layers.

groups.title: PAT and OAuth lifecycle

options.name: PAT family and resource owner
options.values: fine-grained | classic; one resource owner for fine-grained; all versus selected repositories
options.decision_rule: Prefer fine-grained when endpoint supports it, or installation App for long-lived automation. Check unsupported workflows before choosing token.
options.verification: Inspect token family, owner, selected repositories and endpoint-specific permission without showing token.

options.name: Fine-grained approval
options.values: Require administrator approval (documented default) | Do not require administrator approval
options.decision_rule: Keep approval unless owner explicitly chooses otherwise; owners own requests auto-approve. Pending tokens only read public resources.
options.verification: Read pending requests, requested access/expiry and final request state; requester confirms operation after approval.

options.name: Classic access policy
options.values: allow versus restrict classic PAT access, separate from fine-grained approval
options.decision_rule: An approval rule does not control classic PATs; choose both policies and inherited enterprise restrictions.
options.verification: Read both token-family policies and existing token inventory.

options.name: Maximum token lifetime
options.values: organization/enterprise configured maximum per token family; token expiration date
options.decision_rule: Use finite lifetime appropriate to workflow and rotation owner; read actual allowed range from current host rather than inventing universal default.
options.verification: Check expiry and rotation reminder; verify replacement works before revoking old token.

options.name: Request decision API
options.values: action approve | deny; optional reason max1024; GitHub App user/installation tokens only
options.decision_rule: Human reviews requested repositories and permissions; organization App token needs Personal access token requests write. PAT cannot approve itself through this API.
options.verification: Read request ID/state; preserve reason and actor; requester gets notification.

options.name: OAuth app governance
options.values: authorized user grant; organization OAuth restrictions; approved/requested App access
options.decision_rule: Separate user authorization from organization approval and SSO authorization. Never assume OAuth install is GitHub App install.
options.verification: Read app owner/client identity, scopes, organization authorization and last-use evidence.

options.name: Revocation
options.values: revoke organization access; revoke authorization; delete secret; emergency credential revocation
options.decision_rule: Record consequence and affected automation; revoke exposed credential and rotate consumers. Revocation cannot recover original secret.
options.verification: Verify old credential fails and new scoped credential succeeds without logging either.

pitfalls: 403/404 may be SSO/resource-selection/approval restrictions, not absent repository. Changing token scope cannot add rights the token owner lacks.
Do not paste credentials into issue reports, approval reasons, URLs or diagnostic artifacts.

groups.title: App registration versus installation

options.name: Registration owner/distribution
options.values: personal or organization owner; Only on this account | Any account
options.decision_rule: Keep internal app private unless broader distribution requested.
options.verification: Read App ID/slug/owner and installation availability.

options.name: User authorization flow
options.values: up to10 callback URLs; expiring user tokens selected by default; request OAuth during installation; device flow optional
options.decision_rule: Enable only needed flow; keep expiry. Setup URL cannot coexist with requesting user OAuth during installation.
options.verification: Test exact redirect and expiration/refresh path without exposing secrets.

options.name: Post-install configuration
options.values: Setup URL; Redirect on update boolean
options.decision_rule: Use for required onboarding; installation repository selection changes can re-trigger setup.
options.verification: Verify existing installation update preserves completed human configuration.

options.name: Permission/event selection
options.values: No access | Read-only | Read & write as offered; repository/organization/account permissions; events constrained by permissions
options.decision_rule: Choose endpoint minimum; expanded permissions require installation approval.
options.verification: Compare requested registration permissions to currently approved installation permissions.

options.name: Installation repository scope
options.values: All repositories | Only select repositories; installation ID; suspended state
options.decision_rule: Select only necessary repositories; registration, user consent and installation are separate.
options.verification: Read installation repository list and mint a scoped token only for authorized operation.

options.name: Private keys and token lifecycle
options.values: App JWT; installation token; user token; private-key rotation
options.decision_rule: Store keys securely; install token may narrow approved permissions/repos. Rotate by adding replacement, verifying, then removing old key.
options.verification: Verify App identity and token expiry/permissions; do not print PEM/JWT/token.

pitfalls: Uninstalling an external-property App removes its external custom properties; preserve values first.
App permission change is not proof all existing installations accepted the expansion.

groups.title: Webhook security and delivery recovery

options.name: Delivery configuration
options.values: active true/false; config.url HTTPS; content_type json/form; insecure_ssl 0/1; secret stored separately
options.decision_rule: Use HTTPS, verification enabled (0) and high-entropy secret; subscribe only needed events.
options.verification: Read redacted configuration and selected events; validate signature on receiver.

options.name: Receiver behavior
options.values: X-GitHub-Event plus action; X-GitHub-Delivery; 2XX within10seconds
options.decision_rule: Durably enqueue, acknowledge quickly, process idempotently; unknown action is not assumed safe.
options.verification: Inspect receipt, signature failure, queue processing and resulting business object.

options.name: Delivery recovery
options.values: ping; deliveries; delivery detail; redeliver attempt
options.decision_rule: Inspect failures before replay; replay same GUID must not duplicate side effects.
options.verification: Read redelivery result and downstream state; POST acceptance alone is incomplete.

options.name: Retry credentials/runtime
options.values: organization/App/repository webhook permissions; installed runtime/module support
options.decision_rule: Use scope-correct credentials; GITHUB_TOKEN cannot redeliver repository webhooks. Validate sample runtime imports before deployment.
options.verification: Run bounded redelivery test; check response status and error paths.

options.name: History and secret rotation
options.values: original delivery GUID plus attempt IDs/statuses; old/new verifier secret transition
options.decision_rule: Retain payload metadata only under approved data policy; coordinate producer/receiver rotation.
options.verification: Verify latest signature and queue state, preserve original failed delivery and retry evidence.

pitfalls: OAuth-created hooks can be inaccessible to another credential type. Secret plaintext is not recoverable from readback.
Community #126156 reports a stale CommonJS Octokit sample failing ERR_REQUIRE_ESM; current App guide uses .mjs. Verify installed package/runtime, do not cargo-cult old snippet.

groups.title: Audit history and incident evidence preservation

options.name: Read channel/time window
options.values: UI; JSON/CSV export; REST; stream; explicit created/date filters
options.decision_rule: UI default shows3months; enterprise web events180days and Git events7days. Export early; event channel determines completeness.
options.verification: Record earliest/latest timestamps, filters, pages and counts for each channel.

options.name: Git versus API event evidence
options.values: Git clone/fetch/push; API requests; web-origin operations; SSO responses
options.decision_rule: Git REST events exclude some web/API initiated effects; do not equate Git event inventory with all mutations.
options.verification: Correlate request IDs, actor/subject IDs, repository IDs and object timelines.

options.name: Streaming configuration
options.values: destination; active/paused; API request events opt-in; source IP disclosure; available Copilot agent events preview
options.decision_rule: Use enterprise stream for future retention; decide sensitive IP/log access and destination permissions with owner.
