options.verification: Verify receiver ingestion, last event time, health notifications and queryable retained sample.

options.name: Continuity and deduplication
options.values: at-least-once delivery;7day pause buffer; destination-specific acceptance window
options.decision_rule: Keep event IDs and deduplicate; repair misconfiguration within6days. Datadog can reject events older than18hours.
options.verification: Monitor gaps and resume cursor; do not claim backfill predating stream enablement.

options.name: Preservation artifact
options.values: raw read-only export; capture timestamp/host/API version/filter; checksum; restricted storage; separate analysis
options.decision_rule: Preserve original evidence and write an additive change ledger; record renamed/deleted actor IDs. Export before destructive account/policy changes.
options.verification: Verify archive readability and checksums; test incident-responder access without publishing private logs.

options.name: Account export
options.values: requested/in-progress/completed; expiring download link; revoke download link
options.decision_rule: Treat point-in-time personal metadata export separately from repository backup and audit stream.
options.verification: Inspect completed archive structure privately and verify requested revocation.

pitfalls: An empty event slice can be retention, filter, permission or channel loss. GitHub Support does not preserve incident logs for you.
API usage statistics, public Events and repository traffic are not substitutes for retained security audit evidence.

groups.title: Billing budgets, attribution and hard stops

options.name: Budget subject
options.values: budget_scope organization/repository/multi_user_customer/user; enterprise/cost_center on their supported scope endpoints
options.decision_rule: Match payer and subject; do not create a duplicate budget before reading existing overlapping controls.
options.verification: Read budget IDs, scopes, product/SKU and payer; reconcile pages against total_count/has_next_page.

options.name: Pricing selector
options.values: BundlePricing + ai_credits; ProductPricing + product; SkuPricing + SKU
options.decision_rule: Use live supported billing schema, not retired product assumptions.
options.verification: Read chosen selector and resulting budget; export actual SKU usage.

options.name: Amount/enforcement
options.values: budget_amount integer; prevent_further_usage boolean; user/universal must true
options.decision_rule: Set authorized cap; ordinary budget UI hard stop is off by default, alerts alone do not cap spend.
options.verification: Read enforcement and applicable remaining capacity; never disable cap merely to clear an error.

options.name: User budget payload
options.values: user login required for user scope; budget_entity_name empty allowed; optional future expires_at YYYY-MM-DD
options.decision_rule: Explicit user field is required even where generated schema omits it. User budgets always stop usage.
options.verification: Read subject/expiry and test affected user policy without incurring unauthorized charges.

options.name: Alerting
options.values: budget_alerting.will_alert; alert_recipients logins; user-scope alerting unavailable
options.decision_rule: Route supported alerts to responsible humans; distinguish budget notice from product-access or seat request.
options.verification: Read alert recipients and supported scope; verify delivery through authorized process.

options.name: Cost center inclusion
options.values: usage counts toward enterprise by default; exclusion optional
options.decision_rule: Exclude only with approved independent spending authority; keep a cost-center cap.
options.verification: Reconcile organization/user membership and exported attribution against invoice/usage.

options.name: Recovery from blocked usage
options.values: reset cycle; paid usage policy; user limit; organizational/cost-center/enterprise limit; account entitlement
options.decision_rule: Identify limiting layer first; request budget increase from budget owner or wait for reset.
options.verification: Read all applicable controls and report exact failed endpoint/policy; use UI when API is unhealthy.

pitfalls: Community #166810 suggests disabling stop usage; this can permit uncapped charges and is not a safe default. Current official budget order/AI credits supersede old premium-only advice.
Community #206489 reports organization budgets 400 with user-scoped budgets; unconfirmed globally. Preserve error and use UI, do not report zero budgets or delete seats as a workaround.

groups.title: Copilot seats, nested policy and client governance

options.name: Access assignment
options.values: selected users/teams versus broader membership; organization seat versus enterprise-assigned access
options.decision_rule: Start with authorized pilot; identify payer and approval owner. A seat is not a feature policy or budget.
options.verification: Read assigned seats/access and active entitlement for target human.

options.name: Enterprise enforcement
options.values: Enabled; Disabled; Let organizations decide/No policy; selected organizations where offered
options.decision_rule: Read inherited policy first; organization cannot override enterprise enforcement.
options.verification: Inspect effective policy for each target organization and user.

options.name: Unconfigured defaults
options.values: separate default availability policies for GA features and GA models; enterprise-assigned user fallback policy
options.decision_rule: Choose future-feature/model defaults explicitly; do not invent one universal default for every product.
options.verification: Read both defaults and explicit per-feature/model overrides.

options.name: Multiple license conflicts
options.values: same-enterprise usually least restrictive; cross-enterprise usually most restrictive; feature-specific exceptions
options.decision_rule: Evaluate paying org and exact conflict matrix: metrics/public-code privacy/non-GitHub semantic indexing differ.
options.verification: Test target identity effective feature access, not only one organization settings page.

options.name: Separate feature/client switches
options.values: GitHub.com; CLI; Copilot app; cloud agent; review; model availability; preview; feedback; MCP in Copilot
options.decision_rule: Configure each applicable switch; Copilot MCP policy does not govern GitHub MCP in third-party hosts.
options.verification: Read policy supported-surface matrix and verify actual client behavior.

options.name: Cloud-agent organization targeting
options.values: enabled everywhere/disabled/organization-delegated/selected organizations; selected IDs or organization properties
options.decision_rule: Property-based selection is evaluated at configuration time, not continuously on later property edits.
options.verification: Re-read enabled org list after property changes; reconcile intentionally.

options.name: Human lifecycle and cost
options.values: access request; owner approval; onboarding; usage review; inactivity/offboarding
options.decision_rule: Give users instructions, responsible support contact and budget limit; usage metrics are not a productivity ranking.
options.verification: Verify activation and failed access, record approved removal and effective date without deleting review history.

pitfalls: A toggle read is not a seat, model entitlement, client setting or billing verification.
Do not assume organization policy applies to personal users merely accessing an organization repository; policy descriptions define audience.

groups.title: Content exclusion, review and local agent controls

options.name: Repository exclusion syntax
options.values: YAML list of path patterns; /scripts/** versus /scripts/*; case-insensitive fnmatch
options.decision_rule: Use patterns scoped to actual sensitive files; preserve inherited exclusions.
options.verification: Test excluded file and nonexcluded control file for inline/chat/review behavior.

options.name: Organization/enterprise patterns
options.values: repository URL/name mapping to path list; wildcard repository key for filesystem-wide paths
options.decision_rule: Match intended clone URL and seat audience; enterprise and org scopes differ.
options.verification: Inspect merged effective policies and actual resolved repository.

options.name: Propagation and supported clients
options.values: up to30minutes IDE propagation; reload client to refresh; current canonical support matrix
options.decision_rule: Recheck current canonical docs and installed client: older enterprise docs may still say CLI/agents unsupported.
options.verification: Reload VS Code or restart supported IDE then test actual target client.

options.name: Exclusion boundary
options.values: guardrail; indirect access, symlinks, remote filesystems, third-party MCP exceptions
options.decision_rule: Use OS/tool permissions for hard boundaries; content exclusion cannot guarantee every access path.
options.verification: Inspect tool permissions and avoid sensitive-file access in verification.

options.name: CLI/SDK execution
options.values: instructions/agents/skills/plugins/hooks/MCP/LSP; allowed tools/paths; permission handler; model/provider
options.decision_rule: Read installed runtime schema; installation of config does not authorize arbitrary hooks or tools.
options.verification: Bounded session verifies loaded customizations, cancellation, error handling, cleanup and permission prompt.

pitfalls: Content exclusion is not a secret store or filesystem sandbox. Changing model/provider may change data handling and costs.

groups.title: Codespaces policies and secrets

options.name: Idle timeout
options.values: default30minutes; personal timeout plus org maximum; shortest applicable wins
options.decision_rule: Set maximum acceptable inactivity for organization-paid codespaces; terminal output can keep one active.
options.verification: Read policy scope and inspect effective timeout after start/restart.

options.name: Policy targeting
options.values: All repositories | Selected repositories; organization-paid codespaces only
options.decision_rule: Do not claim policy restricts personally paid codespaces. Maximum codespaces per user constraint is organization-wide.
options.verification: Verify payer, targeted IDs and existing codespace next-start behavior.

options.name: Retention and lifecycle
options.values: default30days retention; stop/start/rebuild/delete; machine selection from available list
options.decision_rule: Save uncommitted work before destructive deletion/rebuild; stopping compute does not remove storage charges.
options.verification: Read state, machine and storage; verify committed backup before deletion.

options.name: Additional constraints
options.values: allowed machine types; base-image restrictions; forwarded-port visibility; max codespaces per user
options.decision_rule: Configure individual constraints from real eligible plan UI; preserve intended developer functionality.
options.verification: Create only an authorized bounded sample; verify restrictions and failure message.

options.name: Secret scope
options.values: organization all/private/selected repositories; repository; user selected repositories; encrypted value
options.decision_rule: Use narrowest scope and current public key; never log plaintext; explicitly grant needed additional repository access.
options.verification: List names/scope and test authorized consumer; readback cannot reveal encrypted secret.

pitfalls: Deletion does not erase storage already accrued in the current billing cycle. Shared forwarded ports and terminal traffic can defeat expected idle savings.

groups.title: Custom properties, issue types and shared fields

options.name: Repository property schema
options.values: string/single_select/multi_select/true_false; required/default/allowed_values/values_editable_by as offered
options.decision_rule: Read existing schema and consumers first; preserve property names and values.
options.verification: Read schema and values for new and existing customized repositories.

options.name: External property registration
options.values: installation_id; display_name1..15alphanumeric immutable; App-only namespace
options.decision_rule: Confirm installation permission and lifecycle owner; unregister/uninstall can destroy App-owned values.
options.verification: Read registration as owner (installation token only sees itself); export values before uninstall.

options.name: Issue type
options.values: name; is_enabled boolean; description; gray/blue/green/yellow/orange/red/pink/purple/null color
options.decision_rule: Reuse type ID; disable obsolete type before deleting when preservation matters.
options.verification: Read definitions and representative issue assignments.

options.name: Shared issue field datatype
options.values: text/date/single_select/multi_select/number
options.decision_rule: Choose native semantics; select types require options; not the same object as Project-only field.
options.verification: Read field ID/type and issue values; test visibility with intended collaborator.

options.name: Shared field visibility/options
options.values: restricted | all; organization_members_only deprecated; select option name/description/color/priority
options.decision_rule: Explicit restricted recommended for private metadata; all exposes to anyone able to see issue. Preserve option IDs during update.
options.verification: Read effective visibility and existing values; check host visibility-feature support.

pitfalls: API docs currently default visibility to deprecated organization_members_only; explicitly use restricted on supported versions.
Schema deletion/recreation can break ruleset targeting, reporting and historical issue field values.

groups.title: Personal identity, notifications and human action

options.name: Email/privacy
options.values: primary/verified/public email; keep email private; block pushes exposing private email
options.decision_rule: Preserve verified recovery address; choose noreply Git identity when privacy requested.
options.verification: Inspect public commit/profile and private verification state; never publish recovery address.

options.name: Key purpose
options.values: SSH authentication key versus SSH signing key versus GPG key; read-only/write deploy key separate
options.decision_rule: Keep purpose explicit; public key fingerprint identifies key, not private credential.
options.verification: Read purpose/fingerprint and verify bounded auth or signature; inspect deploy-key grants on offboarding.

options.name: Recovery
options.values: passkeys/security keys/TOTP/recovery codes; active sessions; password reauthentication
options.decision_rule: Require human control of second factors and backup recovery; never save recovery material in shared docs.
options.verification: Owner verifies independent recovery route; revoke only explicitly targeted session/credential.

options.name: Repository watch
options.values: Participating/@mentions; All activity; Ignore; Custom event types
options.decision_rule: Use releases/security/review signals needed by actual maintainer; automatically participating subscription can add noise.
options.verification: Read subscription and intended event categories; intended human verifies notifications.

options.name: Delivery channels
options.values: On GitHub; email; Mobile; participating/watching categories; default/per-org verified email; working hours
options.decision_rule: Keep actionable maintainer notices; personal settings require account owner context.
options.verification: Check inbox/email settings and representative received notification; a sent mention is not proof of delivery.

options.name: Moderation
options.values: block/unblock; organization block differs from personal block; interaction limits
options.decision_rule: Preserve abuse evidence privately; specify affected relationships and access before blocking.
options.verification: Read current block/limit and verify intended scope; avoid unnecessary duplicate contact.

pitfalls: Email replies can create public comments. Notification privacy and contributor consent still matter.
Removing a user does not revoke a deploy key whose private key they retained.

groups.title: Host-specific enterprise lifecycle and support

options.name: Hosting and identity
options.values: github.com | tenant.ghe.com | GHES version; ordinary identities versus managed users
options.decision_rule: Choose actual API/SSH host and product/version docs before credentials or network policy.
options.verification: Read host /meta, enterprise identity and version; do not apply github.com IP/fingerprint snapshot blindly.

options.name: Organization lifecycle
options.values: create; invite existing; transfer; migration importer; pending acceptance
options.decision_rule: EMU cannot import an ordinary organization via simple enterprise invite; cross-host moves need supported migration.
options.verification: Read destination ownership, inherited policy, billing and member access after completion.

options.name: Migration plan
options.values: source/export; destination; locks; import status; warnings; user attribution; redirect behavior
options.decision_rule: Preserve source and export; map humans and permissions; rehearse recovery before destructive cutover.
options.verification: Inspect final migration log, counts, links and sampled historical issues/PR authors/files.

options.name: GHES administration
options.values: backup/restore; maintenance; upgrade; replica/HA; license; support bundle; GitHub Connect
options.decision_rule: Use instance version runbook and verified backups; repo admin is not appliance administrator.
options.verification: Verify backup restore readiness, instance health/version and product connectivity after approved change.

options.name: Support interaction
options.values: entitlement; intended enterprise account; new/existing ticket; attachment; reply; status
options.decision_rule: Prepare redacted reproduction and preserve case history; submission/reply contacts another party and needs explicit instruction.
options.verification: Read actual ticket ID/submitted content/status; form preparation alone is not submission.

pitfalls: Migration/API success does not prove review history, actor attribution or every product artifact migrated.
Support attachments can have unauthenticated URLs; redact before upload.

groups.title: Organization rules and hosted networking

options.name: Ruleset nested scope
options.values: target branch/tag/push where supported; enforcement disabled/active/evaluate; repository/ref include/exclude conditions; bypass actors/modes
options.decision_rule: Preserve target conditions and bypass IDs; evaluate mode measures without enforcement. Detail rule parameters in delivery-security reference.
options.verification: Read each ruleset, inherited sources and rule suites for sample pushes; list alone proves little.

options.name: Network configuration
options.values: name1..100 letters/numbers/._-; compute_service none/actions; exactly one network_settings_ids entry
options.decision_rule: Use provisioned network resource and proper compute attachment; a configuration alone attaches no runner.
options.verification: Read network setting and attached runner group plus actual connectivity.

options.name: Failover network
options.values: failover_network_settings_ids exactly one when configured; failover_network_enabled boolean
options.decision_rule: Choose failover only with independently tested connectivity and owner-approved network policy.
options.verification: Read failover configuration; bounded connectivity/failover test and rollback route.

pitfalls: Push, branch and tag rules have different plan gates. Network API response examples showing multiple IDs conflict with current exactly-one request rule; current parameter constraint wins.

groups.title: Agent automation, task execution and human handoff

options.name: Automation ownership
options.values: type personal/shared; enabled; require_actor_write_permission; continuous_history
options.decision_rule: Personal belongs to creator; shared is repository-readable and writer-manageable. Read repository allow-automations policy.
options.verification: Read repository scope, creator and permitted actors; user-global list omits others shared automations.

options.name: Schedule and event triggers
options.values: cadence hourly/daily/weekly; hour_utc0..23; day_of_week0..6; minute_utc0/15/30/45 (omit with hourly); query/labels/workflow filters
options.decision_rule: Default daily/weekly midnight UTC, weekly Monday; choose explicitly with timezone conversion.
options.verification: Read trigger fields and next/actual run time; preserve prior run history.

options.name: Trigger authority
options.values: write_scope trigger/repository; allow_copilot_triggers false default
options.decision_rule: Scheduled write_scope has no effect: scheduled runs can change entire repo. Keep Copilot-trigger loops disabled unless explicitly reviewed.
options.verification: Read effective scope/policy; test trigger actor and targeted object.

options.name: Task request
options.values: prompt; model from current plan list; custom_agent filename stem; create_pull_request false default; base_ref/head_ref
options.decision_rule: Prompt must describe authorized work. Existing head_ref can receive commits; inspect branch/PR before start.
options.verification: Read task/session/artifact and resulting diff; starting task is not completion.

options.name: Task states/history
options.values: queued/in_progress/completed/failed/idle/waiting_for_user/timed_out/cancelled; is_archived false default
options.decision_rule: Include archived records in history inventory; waiting_for_user needs actual human answer.
options.verification: Read final state/output/errors and linked PR; retain original failed attempt before retry.

options.name: Secrets/variables/team customization
options.values: secret encryption key/value and repository visibility; plain variables; prompt/tool configuration
options.decision_rule: Never put secret in variable or prompt; preserve custom agents/tools and follow actual endpoint scope.
options.verification: Read names/selection and bounded consumer output; no plaintext secret readback.

pitfalls: Public-preview surfaces change. App installation tokens support shared automations but not ordinary agent-task start/list; choose endpoint-specific authentication.
No retry may silently create another billable task or duplicate PR; reread task/artifacts first.

groups.title: Copilot Spaces and private registry access

options.name: Space default access
options.values: base_role no_access(default)/reader/writer/admin; name/description/general_instructions
options.decision_rule: Keep no_access until audience approved; discover direct collaborators separately.
options.verification: Read default/direct roles and test intended audience.

options.name: Space resource types
options.values: repository/github_file/free_text/github_issue/github_pull_request/media_content/uploaded_text_file; type-specific metadata
options.decision_rule: Preserve resource IDs and private context; fine-grained/user tokens need every referenced repository.
options.verification: Read resource details; list can omit whole Spaces with inaccessible resources, so incomplete list remains unknown.

options.name: Registry access
options.values: visibility all/private/selected; selected_repository_ids only with selected; replaces_base false default
options.decision_rule: Select repositories and decide whether public-registry fallback is acceptable.
options.verification: Read visibility, selected IDs and successful bounded dependency resolution.

options.name: Registry authentication
options.values: token(default)/username_password/oidc_azure/oidc_aws/oidc_jfrog/oidc_cloudsmith/oidc_gcp/anonymous
options.decision_rule: Token/password require encrypted_value/key_id; OIDC omit them; anonymous also omits username. Use provider-specific fields from current schema.
options.verification: Read redacted auth config and external trust mapping; verify authorized resolution, not secret plaintext.

options.name: Provider-specific identity
options.values: Azure tenant_id/client_id; AWS region/account/role/domain/domain_owner; JFrog provider/audience; Cloudsmith namespace/service_slug/audience; GCP workload_identity_provider/service_account
options.decision_rule: Grant narrow external trust; GCP service_account optional for direct WIF. Cloudsmith api_host defaults api.cloudsmith.io.
options.verification: Verify actual issuer/audience/subject and repository binding with external administrator.

pitfalls: Space sharing and source repository access are distinct; do not widen source access to make inventory look complete.
Credential rotation and trust-provider setup require both GitHub and registry-side verification.

groups.title: Organization defaults, repository history and storage

options.name: Community defaults/profile
options.values: public .github defaults; repository-specific overrides; .github/profile/README.md and member profile where supported
options.decision_rule: Reuse organization defaults without overwriting repository custom documents; distinguish public/member audience.
options.verification: Inspect rendered repository community profile and org profile with correct identity.

options.name: Repository lifecycle
options.values: visibility public/private/internal; archived; owner/name/default branch; delete versus archive
options.decision_rule: Check fork network, billing, actions/pages and collaborator consequences. Preserve history and transferable objects before move/delete.
options.verification: Read metadata and history/redirect/access after change; archive is read-only, not backup.

options.name: LFS configuration
options.values: .gitattributes tracked patterns; LFS object store; pointers; quota/billing; migration rewritten history
options.decision_rule: Track only required files; git clone/mirror without LFS object fetch is insufficient backup. History rewrite requires coordinated human cutover.
options.verification: Fetch/check LFS objects; verify fresh checkout and collaborators migration instructions.

options.name: Insights/preservation
options.values: traffic/clones/views; contributors/stats async response; Preserve this repository on/off
options.decision_rule: Capture ephemeral metric window before expiry. Archive Program opt-out only affects future preservation.
options.verification: Read completed statistics and preservation setting; never equate UI archival, source export and long-term program.

options.name: Retired Models workflow
options.values: historical GitHub Models integration/configuration; retired endpoints
options.decision_rule: Preserve source/cost history, discover supported replacement only when requested; no new deployment against retired service.
options.verification: Check endpoint retirement notice and installed integration; mark unavailable with dated evidence.

pitfalls: No repository deletion or history rewrite is implied by full setup. A metadata snapshot cannot restore repository/LFS/product history.

groups.title: Human-facing sharing, Classroom and Spark

options.name: Social profile and subscriptions
options.values: follow/unfollow; social account URLs; star/unstar; public/private authenticated feeds
options.decision_rule: Only change owner-requested preferences; feed URLs can embed sensitive tokens.
options.verification: Read actual relationship/profile/feed scope without logging private feed URLs.

options.name: Gist publication/history
options.values: public true/false on creation; description/files; file rename/delete; revisions/forks/comments
options.decision_rule: Secret gist is unlisted, not access-controlled private storage; never put secrets there. Preserve revision before edits.
options.verification: Read visibility/files/history and comment IDs; inspect audience before publishing.

options.name: Classroom assignment
options.values: classroom/assignment ID; individual/group; accepted assignment repositories; students/teams; grades
options.decision_rule: Use teacher authority and preserve student privacy; acceptance and grading are separate human actions.
options.verification: Read actual assignment, accepted repositories and grades with correct classroom scope.

options.name: Spark publishing/data
options.values: private/organization/all-GitHub-users where eligible; shared app data read-only/write; preview versus published version
options.decision_rule: Publication and data-write audience need explicit scope; managed users cannot publish to all GitHub users.
options.verification: Read publication URL/version/audience and verify authorized viewer/data operation.

pitfalls: Commenting, following and invitations affect other humans. Read-only discovery is not permission to contact or publish.

groups.title: Platform diagnostics and templates

options.name: Host metadata
options.values: GET /meta; API versions; SSH fingerprints; IP/domain lists
options.decision_rule: Use real host metadata and documented exceptions; avoid rewriting firewall from partial snapshot.
options.verification: Verify host identity and freshness before applying any external network change.

options.name: Quota and retry
options.values: core/search/GraphQL resource budgets; x-ratelimit-*; retry-after; GraphQL cost/reset
options.decision_rule: Obey primary and secondary throttles; positive core remaining does not rule out secondary limit.
options.verification: Record failed request/status/headers; retry under documented delay and verify object state first.

options.name: Catalog templates
options.values: SPDX license ID; detected license file; gitignore template name; emoji shortcode
options.decision_rule: Owner chooses license; preserve custom ignore rules; catalog discovery does not authorize relicensing.
options.verification: Read actual committed license; git check-ignore plus tracked-file inspection; verify chosen shortcode.

options.name: Markdown rendering
options.values: mode markdown/gfm; repository context; raw rendering endpoint
options.decision_rule: Context changes issue/user link resolution; rendering POST does not publish comment or file.
options.verification: Inspect returned HTML and context-sensitive links in intended renderer.

pitfalls: A successful render or catalog lookup proves only that lookup. It is not evidence of repository configuration or publication.
